item.title: 2nd Democratic Challenger To DeLauro Emerges
item.description: Another first-time candidate has filed papers to challenge New Haven U.S. Rep. Rosa DeLauro for the Democratic nomination next year -- potentially the third challenge from the left that the liberal lion has faced in 36 years. item.title: Westville Weighs In On Parking Plan For Crossroads Lot
item.description: With 32 new parking spaces en route to a long-vacant lot bounded by Whalley Avenue and Fountain Street, neighbors gathered for a Parking Authority-hosted meeting to debate: Does Westville really need more parking? item.title: Anti-Avelo Billboards Return
item.description: In between ads for Electric Boat and Executive Cleaners, a pair of handcuffed hands -- and the message "Don't Fly Avelo!" -- now loom over an Annex stretch of I-95, thanks to a renewed campaign by a New Hampshire state lawmaker to boycott the deportation-flying budget airline.
